channel.title: Orielsy Diaz — Research & Writing
channel.description: Technical essays, architecture explorations, and systems design by Orielsy Diaz.

item.title: Architecture Notes: Audio Stream Windowing, VAD Gating, and Real-Time Speech UI Systems
item.description: A technical exploration of the trade-offs in streaming audio buffer management, PyAnnote VAD silence gating, Whisper hallucination suppression, and high-performance Electron overlay rendering.

item.title: AI as a UI Capability, Not Just a Chatbot
item.description: Rethinking generative AI as an ambient interface capability—powering structured extraction, semantic ranking, and inline adaptive transformations rather than conversational bubbles.

item.title: Context Engineering for Software Development
item.description: Designing persistent repository knowledge architectures and Model Context Protocol (MCP) systems that provide autonomous coding agents with relevant context while eliminating context pollution.

item.title: Reducing Prompt Dependency via Specification-Driven AI Development
item.description: Externalizing software intent, state transition contracts, and architectural constraints into persistent structured artifacts rather than ephemeral conversational prompts.
